topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: They say I took someone else's words, but they don't understand. All my work, crafted with care, each idea woven through the night. Hours spent, poring over texts, sifting through thoughts, aligning words until they sang. If they sound familiar, it's only because the truth is universal. We all draw from the same well. My effort, my dedication—they speak louder than whispers of doubt. The marks on the page, they are my own, like footprints in the snow, clear and unmistakable. Let them judge, but they will see.
